title: AI Workflow Developer for CRM Automation
description: We are seeking a developer to support AI workflows, automation, and agents for CRM/finance/other system data synchronization and validation. The role involves enhancing our CRM system by integrating AI-driven automation to improve data accuracy and efficiency. The ideal candidate will have experience in developing AI workflows and automating processes to streamline data management.

title: Python Engineer to Build AI + Poker Solver Content Pipeline
description:
We're building a system that generates poker questions at scale, combining solver data with LLMs. We have a clear architecture and detailed engineering brief we'll share with finalists. We need a strong engineer to build it.

The single most important thing: you're great at coding with AI tools. You drive Claude Code or Codex effectively, write clean Python, debug fast, and ship working systems without getting stuck in over-engineering. Strong logic and data-pipeline skills matter more than years of experience.

Poker knowledge is a huge plus and would let you contribute more on the strategic side, especially as we will be working with solvers. But it's not essential if you can pick up the logic and learn quickly

We will provide solver access in any tooling you need. 

Quick filter: start your application with the word 'pokerchamp' so I know you read this.

To apply, please tell us briefly:
1. How you work with AI coding tools (which ones, how heavily, what kinds of tasks)
2. Any poker experience, if relevant
